deferral_rationale: SLICE + DEV subsystems have well-characterized structure from Phases 1-5; return-on-modeling low for T0.14 kickoff walk. Deferred to walk-instance #2+ post-Phase-2 PoC.

findings.description: 4 of 5 actors (ACT-PB-2..5) declared type: human but represent system-agents (LLM Agent, MCP Consumer, arch-agent Trainer, CI/CD Pipeline). Only ACT-PB-1 (User) is genuinely human.

21 components declare source_paths pointing to files that do not exist (src/architecture_model/core/promise.py, pipeline_v3/*, migration/*, quality/chain_closure.py, sil/evidence.py). Plan-B is 100% spec, 0% code.

Root capability CAP-0 has description claiming 'four umbrella capabilities' but actually contains 5 (SLICE, MODEL, EXTRACT, DEV, DF). Has no failure_modes, no verification, no requirements — thinnest branch of top layer.
CAP-DF branch has 5 leaves with structured verification but zero components allocated (before T0.14). Methodology unrealized.
BEH↔COMP allocation uses traces-to (loose semantic) rather than realizes (strong allocation). Creates orphan-realization warnings in validator.
CAP-PB-MODEL.goals[1] already specifies Promise-graph as target. My prior Paths A/B/C/D/E attribute-flow inventions were archaeologically behind the model.
findings.remediation: Path P (Promise-graph as designed) confirmed as direction; supersedes A-E

findings.description: CAP-PB-MODEL describes schema 3.0 using schema 2.1 primitives; its own goals are string-lists — the very shape 3.0 abolishes. AMS 2.1 buckles under load of describing 3.0.
findings.remediation: Phase 2 PoC migrates one entity (CAP-PB-PIPELINE) to prove Promise-graph round-trip

findings.description: open_questions self-diagnoses: SIOs are behaviors under CAP-DF-SELFIMP (current) or first-class YAML top-level (needs schema extension)? Behaviors overload behavior semantics.

findings.description: CAP-DF had 5 leaves (INTENT/EVOLVE/VERIFY/SELFIMP/GATING) but the full dev-flow cycle needs INTAKE + GENESIS + WALK + EVOLVE. Missing GENESIS + WALK as first-class sub-caps.
INV-DF-REGEN referenced throughout plan-b but scoring rubric never written down. Every commit tally applied by ad-hoc assessment.

7-stage trigger chain traced end-to-end (observe→infer→allocate→relate→specify→contract→validate); no further depth needed for T0.14 kickoff
Dataclass shape verified from description (id/attribute/content/owner/delivered_from/verified_by/status/gap_type/provenance); Phase 1 will implement the code

outcome: T0.14 plan authored (docs/plans/2026-09-14-t0.14-v3-bootstrap.md); Path P confirmed as direction; Phase 0 + 0.5 execution began this walk-instance.
